_meta.title: Voiceover (VibeVoice Realtime-0.5B stock voices / 1.5B clone)
_meta.description: Text-to-speech: wildminder/ComfyUI-VibeVoice (VibeVoiceTTS). Default = stock voice: VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B (models/tts/VibeVoice/VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B, MIT) reading with a cached voice prompt (voice_preset = models/tts/VibeVoice/voices/<id>.pt from microsoft/VibeVoice demo/voices/streaming_model, MIT). Clone engine: the builder switches to VibeVoice-1.5B and wires LoadAudio (node 1) into speaker_1_voice; for stock voices it deletes the unconnected LoadAudio. Builder: src/lib/oj/voiceSound.ts. Output MP3 via SaveAudioMP3.
